content.title: Brock Lesnar retires at WrestleMania 42
content.text: PRO WRESTLINGBrock Lesnar's emotional exit at WrestleMania 42 hints at retirementAsbury Park PressApril 19, 2026, 6:25 p.m. ET0:32/1:15Keep WatchingBrock Lesnar seemingly retired at WrestleMania 42.After he lost his match to Oba Femi, he sat in the ring. After Femi left he arena, an emotional Lesnar took off his gloves, then took off his shoes and exited the ring. He was embraced by his longtime friend and advocate Paul Heyman.The fans chanted "Thank you Brock" after he made it clear thi was his last match. He kissed the ring and then left.Lesnar, a former UFC heavyweight champion, has been with WWE, off and on, since 2000.Need a news break?
